summary.text: Blood-Kin Heart Revenge is Fang Zheng's blood path killer move, made after he became Demon Judgment Board Lord, that marks Cooking Luck Pot and corrodes Fang Yuan's luck.

claims.text: Amid the fight at Heavenly Court, a blood cloud with a peculiar aura approaches Fang Yuan; daybreak flying swords tear it apart, yet ordinary cooking of luck cannot clear the threat without full concentration and a large spend of time. The red tombstone Immortal Gu House Demon Judgment Board closes in with Gu Yue Fang Zheng and Qin Ding Ling inside; Fang Zheng thanks her for amplifying his killer move. The blood path method mimics luck path and also holds human path profundity, with Qin Ding Ling’s help only icing on the cake. When it activates again, the blood cloud keeps chasing him even though he has used sovereign immortal fetus Gu, which leaves him uncertain because that body has no bloodline tie to Fang Zheng.

Fang Yuan judges the move more likely tracks a mental connection than bloodline alone, since his sovereign body has no blood relationship with Fang Zheng and his rank six time path clone sits isolated in the aperture. The connection has three aspects: bloodline, mental connection, and luck connection; luck resonance lets the blood markings corrode his luck. The same effect would not appear if others used the move; Fang Zheng is closely tied to him as a heaven’s will arrangement, and their lucks already show that link, as when Fang Zheng’s luck became a pot lid after Fang Yuan obtained Cooking Luck Pot. He first names the all living beings luck inheritance, then corrects himself: heart blood Immortal Gu alone would ease the pressure even if he could not unravel the move. That sensation came at the qi sea banquet, where he failed to obtain the Gu.
Fang Zheng credits hardships during the continental war in Lang Ya blessed land with letting him merge past Demon Judgment Board Lords’ cultivation experience into blood-kin heart revenge.
